about_the_game:
Welcome to Starry Trace!

A relaxing yet brain-teasing puzzle game featuring 100+ addictive levels with escalating difficulty. Ready to test your skills?

Choose a star, leave your mark!

Tap the star you want to move, but remember: you can only switch stars after clearing all from the grid.

Fill the grid, complete the pattern!

Finish the target design within the allowed moves to win. Simple controls, but mastering it takes strategy!

Game Features

  • Limited Moves: Plan carefully to solve puzzles in minimal steps.

  • Progressive Unlocks: Beat a level to unlock the next—get ready for tougher challenges!

  • Random Mode: Enjoy fresh puzzles every time with infinite randomized stages.

  • Speed Run: Stop the timer when you finish—race against the clock!

  • Chill Soundtrack: Soothing BGM keeps you relaxed even during marathon sessions.

🎉 Start Your Celestial Adventure Now! 🎉

Whether you’re sharpening your mind or unwinding, Starry Trace delivers endless fun. Who will become the ultimate "Starry Artist"?

short_description: Starry Trace is a relaxing puzzle game where players create colorful grid by strategically moving stars. Solve 100+ challenging levels with limited moves, and enjoy endless randomized puzzles. Features calming music, minimalist art, and a mix of strategy and casual play for all skill levels.
